_comment: Ratcheting allowlists for scripts/check_dependency_layers.py. These capture the pre-migration state as of Davis-Kahan fc38eb4 so the checker is green today and flags only NEW regressions. Entries are transitional backwards-dependencies that later extraction PRs remove; do not add to these lists to work around the architecture.  `production_imports_spectra` (added 2026-07-28) is the burn-down list for rule 7: production modules that reach Spectra directly rather than through DavisKahan.Interop.Spectra. AGENTS.md states the final migration target removes Spectra from the normal build, and three extraction clusters are blocked-on-spectra-removal; this list makes the coupling visible and, being ratcheting, keeps new coupling out. It may only shrink.
